shared_elements: winged anthropomorphic figure in profile striding right-to-left orientation
raised arm with open hand/held object at upper left
second lowered arm holding an object (bucket/vessel or cone)
large detailed wing with layered rows of feathers
fringed and tasselled garment with patterned bands
bracelet and armlet with rosette bosses
near-full-height single figure filling the panel
justification: Both depict a single large striding winged genius in profile, one arm raised holding a cone-like/rosette object and the other lowered with a handled vessel, wearing the same fringed, tasselled and cross-hatched garment, rosette-studded bracelets and sandals, with elaborately layered wing feathers rendered in identical registers. The only substantive difference in content is the head: A has a raptor's head with beak and crest while B has a bearded human head with diadem, and A includes a dense stylised tree of rosettes at the left that B lacks.
